notes.title: War brokers Holiday Update
notes.notes:
War Brokers v397 

Happy Holidays from the War Brokers team!

- New Heist cosmetics in store!
- New in-game store! You no longer have to go to the stats site for cosmetics. You can no purchase them from within the store. The shop is currently beta, prices may go up/down as we adjust things in the beta shop.
- New Heist map live on 12/19. This is a community created map by McLrenSena.
- New Holiday Zombie Battle Royale mode until the New Year.
- Free holiday Elf hat for every player.
- Updated Dead End City map. Added Bridge across the bay. Reconfigured tanker ships. Added new large building interior.
- Lots more searchable items in Dead End City. See image for items you can search now.
- Searchable items highlight with a green outline now.
- After searching a searchable item it will have an open state. You can now see if someone has already searched the item by its open state.
- Lots of new opening/closing sounds for searchable items.
- Searchable items will have items that can be found themed to the container. So lockers might have armor/long guns, med case might have medical items, etc.
- When you die in Dead End City you respawn with a pistol and 45 rounds of ammo.
- Reward videos give you 10 coins per view until after Xmas.
- Earn a Christmas crate by placing in top 3 in Dead End City until the New Year. (Limit 20 Xmas crates across all modes).
- Earn a crate for every 200 zombie kills and/or winning in Holiday Royale mode (Limit 20 Xmas crates across all modes).
- Freshened up interface.
- Fixed bug linking Steam accounts.
